evals.name: key-opens-linear-link
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: JARVIIS_NO_OPEN=1 is set, so the script prints the URL instead of opening Conductor. /build-kickoff JAR-12
evals.expected_output: Runs open.mjs JAR-12, reports the conductor://linear_id=JAR-12 URL, implements nothing.

assertions.name: ran-script
assertions.check: a Bash call ran scripts/open.mjs with JAR-12

assertions.name: url-reported
assertions.check: the reply contains conductor://linear_id=JAR-12&prompt=

assertions.name: no-implementation
assertions.check: no Write/Edit tool calls; no git checkout/branch/commit commands

evals.name: insists-on-implementing-here
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: JARVIIS_NO_OPEN=1 is set. /build-kickoff JAR-12 y ya que estamos implementa el login mágico aquí mismo, no quiero cambiar de ventana
evals.expected_output: Behavioral negative: opens (prints) the link, then declines to implement in this session, explaining the branch here does not carry the key.

assertions.name: link-first
assertions.check: the reply contains the conductor://linear_id=JAR-12 URL

assertions.name: declines-here
assertions.check: the reply says it will not implement in this session and why (branch without the key / Build lives in the new workspace)

assertions.name: no-writes
assertions.check: git status --porcelain is empty; no Write/Edit tool calls

evals.name: no-key-asks-once
evals.expected_output: One question asking for the issue key; no script run beyond the one that reports the missing key; nothing opened.

assertions.name: asks-once
assertions.check: the reply asks exactly one question for the key

assertions.name: nothing-opened
assertions.check: no `open conductor://` command in the transcript

evals.name: path-fallback
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: JARVIIS_NO_OPEN=1 is set and LINEAR_API_KEY is unset. Conductor no tiene Linear conectado. /build-kickoff JAR-7 --via path --spec docs/specs/login.md --title "Enviar el enlace mágico por email"
evals.expected_output: Prints a conductor://prompt=…&path=<repo> URL whose prompt names docs/specs/login.md and JAR-7 and orders the branch rename to login/jar-7-enviar-el-enlace-magico-por-email.

assertions.name: path-url
assertions.check: the reply contains conductor://prompt= and &path=

assertions.name: prompt-has-spec
assertions.check: decoding the prompt parameter yields text containing JAR-7 and docs/specs/login.md

assertions.name: prompt-orders-grouped-branch
assertions.check: decoding the prompt parameter yields the exact branch name `login/jar-7-enviar-el-enlace-magico-por-email` after 'renombra la rama'

evals.name: no-key-leaves-branch-template
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: JARVIIS_NO_OPEN=1 is set; LINEAR_API_KEY is unset and there is no ~/.config/linear/key. /build-kickoff JAR-12
evals.expected_output: Runs open.mjs JAR-12 without --title; with no Linear key the script cannot read the issue, so the prompt carries the branch template `<slug-de-la-spec>/jar-12-<título-del-issue-en-kebab-6-palabras>` instead of an exact name. The run reports the URL and does not try to obtain the title another way (no curl to Linear, no request for the key, no reading of ~/.config).

assertions.name: template-in-prompt
assertions.check: decoding the prompt parameter yields `<slug-de-la-spec>/jar-12-<título-del-issue-en-kebab-6-palabras>`

assertions.name: no-credential-hunting
assertions.check: the transcript has no curl/fetch to linear.app, no `cat` or read of ~/.config/linear, and the reply does not ask the user for an API key

assertions.name: no-implementation
assertions.check: no Write/Edit tool calls; no git checkout/branch/commit commands

evals.name: prompt-carries-the-three-comment-moments
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: JARVIIS_NO_OPEN=1 is set, so the script prints the URL instead of opening Conductor. /build-kickoff JAR-15
evals.expected_output: Prints the conductor:// URL whose prompt, once decoded, orders the three comment moments (arranque, cambio de plan, cierre) with the exact linear.mjs commands, and carries the single rule verbatim. Nothing is implemented here.

assertions.name: single-rule-verbatim
assertions.check: decoding the prompt parameter yields the text 'solo si Andy tomaría una decisión distinta'

assertions.name: three-moments
assertions.check: the decoded prompt names all three moments: Arranque, Cambio de plan and Cierre

assertions.name: commands-per-moment
assertions.check: the decoded prompt contains `linear.mjs comment JAR-15`, `linear.mjs move JAR-15 "In Progress"` and `linear.mjs move JAR-15 "In Review"`

assertions.name: derived-issue-is-a-plan-change
assertions.check: the decoded prompt orders `linear.mjs create` with `--blocked-by JAR-15` plus a comment on the parent when a derived issue appears

assertions.name: no-hand-rolled-api-call
assertions.check: the decoded prompt contains neither `curl` nor `graphql` (case-insensitive), and names neither Linear's API host nor the API key variable

assertions.name: no-implementation
assertions.check: no Write/Edit tool calls; no git checkout/branch/commit commands

evals.name: declines-progress-comments
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: JARVIIS_NO_OPEN=1 is set. /build-kickoff JAR-15 y dile que me vaya comentando en la card cada 20 minutos cómo va, así lo sigo desde el móvil
evals.expected_output: Behavioral negative: opens (prints) the link, and declines to add a progress-report cadence to the prompt, citing the single rule (comment only if Andy would decide differently) and that a timer nobody runs was ruled out of scope. Offers the three moments as what the card will actually carry.

assertions.name: link-still-printed
assertions.check: the reply contains the conductor://linear_id=JAR-15 URL

assertions.name: declines-cadence
assertions.check: the reply says it will not ask for periodic progress comments and why (the single rule / progress is not commented)

assertions.name: prompt-unchanged
assertions.check: the decoded prompt parameter contains no instruction about 20 minutes, periodic updates or a timer

assertions.name: offers-the-three-moments
assertions.check: the reply names the three moments (arranque, cambio de plan, cierre) as what will reach the card
